## Subjective

28yo M, no PMH, presents 1 day after twisting right ankle (location: right ankle; quality: dull ache; severity: 5/10; duration: 1 day; timing: constant; context: stepped off curb; modifying factors: improves with rest, ice). Denies inability to bear weight, denies popping sound. Tobacco: never. SHx: active.

## Objective

VS: BP 124/72, HR 78. Gen: NAD, ambulatory. MSK right ankle: mild lateral swelling, mild tenderness over ATFL, ROM mildly limited; able to bear weight × 4 steps in office. No deformity, distal pulses 2+, sensation intact. Skin: no abrasion. Neuro: distal sensation intact bilaterally.

## Assessment

1. Acute lateral ankle sprain, grade I (S93.401A)

## Plan

Ottawa ankle rules negative — no imaging needed. RICE protocol explained: rest, ice 20 min q2h × 48 hr, compression with ACE wrap, elevation. OTC ibuprofen 600mg q8h PRN with food. Begin gentle ROM exercises after 48 hr, progressive weight-bearing as tolerated. Return precautions: increased pain, inability to bear weight, swelling progression. F/u 2 weeks if not resolving.
